summary: fooling around, youngest on ukele. Had tablature open. Brothers stomped knowingly down the stairs, "just A and G, easy" So I play Dark Star. Complexity dripping in Nothing and everything Driven by A and G #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
fooling
around, youngest
on ukele.
Had tablature open.
Brothers stomped
knowingly down the stairs,
"just A and G, easy"
So I play Dark Star.
Complexity dripping in
Nothing and everything
Driven by
A and G
#smallpoems
